title: On-device conversion is live
body: Model conversion now runs **entirely on device** — no upload, no queue. Read the [release notes](https://example.com/releases) for the full list.

title: How is the new converter working out?
body: You have converted a few models this week. *One tap* is enough — we read every answer.

title: Scheduled maintenance
body: Sync will be unavailable on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC.

cs.title: Plánovaná údržba
cs.body: Synchronizace nebude v neděli mezi 02:00 a 04:00 UTC dostupná.

title: Model licences updated
body: The attribution list has changed. Matched no override — this is the source text.

title: Markdown is inline-only
body: This renders **bold**, *italic*, `code spans`, and [links](https://example.com). Block syntax does not: a leading # or a - bullet stays literal, and line breaks are preserved as written.

title: Early access opens Saturday
body: The ONNX importer opens to everyone on **1 August**. Nothing to do — it appears by itself.

title: Update available
body: Builds before 2.0 cannot open the new catalog format. Updating takes a moment.

title: Model licences
body: Detection models ship under their original licences — see [the attribution list](https://example.com/licences). Conversion never sends your models anywhere.

title: Looking for annotation frequency?
body: It moved into **Annotation** at the top of this screen.

title: Welcome back
body: Sign in to sync your findings across devices. Interactive prompts never appear on this screen.
